findings.note: unresolved/resolved is THREAD state, not code state. An unresolved thread may already be fixed and awaiting a reply; isOutdated only tracks whether the anchored hunk moved. Treat these as 'what the reviewer has not yet been told is closed', never as 'what is still broken'.

items.excerpt: P2 Preserve trailing whitespace in checkout paths. Trimming the entire entry changes the path before any evidence is read.
P2 Export the attached-roots variable in the setup example. A bare assignment is not inherited by the guard subprocess.
P2 Report malformed registries on the merge path. The parse problem was discarded, so the real cause was never surfaced.
P2 Preserve the registered loop's refusal reason. A bad-receipt foreign state was discarded, so the operator saw the project root's unrelated error.
P2 Let the merge checker diagnose the registered receipt. The pre-check pre-empted checkMerge's own identity comparison.
P2 Preserve filesystem semantics when normalizing roots. path.normalize collapses '..' lexically while POSIX resolves a preceding symlink first.

P2 Preserve trailing backslashes in POSIX checkout paths. The character class /[\\/]+$/ treats a legal POSIX filename character as a Windows separator and strips it, rewriting /checkouts/repo\ to /checkouts/repo, despite the docs stating only a trailing carriage return is stripped. Strip only the platform's actual separator after path.normalize.
